selection: repeat whose phases (d01,d12,d23,d34,d45,d57,total) are jointly closest to the cell medians
anonymization: consistent pseudonyms: account ids, instance/AMI/subnet/VPC/SG/LT/fleet/ENI/volume/snapshot ids, hosted-zone ids, UUIDs (request ids), Slurm SLUIDs, private and public IPs (and ip-a-b-c-d hostnames), MACs, personal names. The mapping is not saved. Timestamps, node names, cluster name, instance type, AZ, and software versions are kept.
caveats: t0 for this cell was synthesized from squeue (notes=acct_synthesized_from_squeue)
job_output event uses the driver's done_ts; the file itself has no timestamp
boot_stage(derived) rows expand timestamps inside one agent_boot_stages record
